interpretation: Mechanism evidence and compartment limits; no transferable vaccine rate constants

free_slp_node_apc_first_arrival_fraction.limit: One dosed peptide lineage with one specified core occurrence is counted at first arrival; the bound is physical, not a calibrated interval

mrna_antigen_arrivals_per_input_transcri.limit: Repeated translation can yield more than one antigen per transcript; no finite upper bound follows without construct-specific production data

intrinsic_blood_core_half_life_hours.limit: Blood input can continue after injection; a post-peak half-decline is not an elimination half-life

surface_pmhc_lifetime_hours.limit: Presentation time courses combine continuing loading, cross-dressing, APC turnover and complex loss

calibration_requirements.measurement: Document the actual free-peptide or carrier-bound transcript amount, chemical form, route, organism and formulation; distinguish it from total formulation mass.
Measure intact parent and identified target-bearing fragments over time in injection-site fluid, lymph, node and blood; carrier or fluorescent-label signal alone does not identify intact target.
Pair intracellular active RNA with completed antigen production and secretion for the actual transcript, carrier and cell context; uptake alone does not identify productive expression.
Pair target-fragment measurements with allele-specific surface pMHC time courses, APC location and cell counts; quantify loading and turnover separately where identifiable.
Distinguish complexes acquired from producer cells from newly loaded APC complexes using donor and recipient alleles, pathway perturbations and matched surface time courses.

Separate soluble from cell-surface enzyme exposure; test current-fragment uptake, processing and loading at multiple concentrations with competing MHC ligands rather than assuming one shared first-order rate.
Hold out relevant constructs, donors or studies after checking source overlap. Test timing as well as amount; connecting pMHC exposure to immune response requires its own matched validation.

studies.scope: Mouse IM OVA and GFP reporter mRNA-LNP, 1 microgram RNA each; 25D1.16 SIINFEKL/H-2Kb flow-cytometry ratio on GFP-positive draining-node cDC2
studies.finding: Relative surface pMHC peaked on day 1, remained above control through day 5 and was not detected on day 7
studies.limit: Relative MFI is not absolute pMHC copies; continued expression/loading and changing APCs prevent an intrinsic complex lifetime or transferable human rate

studies.scope: Mouse mRNA-LNP vaccination and APC-restricted antigen-expression experiments
studies.finding: Endogenous antigen expression in APCs supports optimal CD4 priming; excluding antigen expression from muscle cells had a much smaller effect in the tested systems
studies.limit: Supports a direct APC processing route, including MHC-II; does not establish human pathway fractions or universal rate constants

studies.scope: Rodent and nonhuman-primate intramuscular mRNA-LNP trafficking and expressed protein
studies.finding: mRNA and expressed antigen occur in injection-site cells and draining lymph nodes
studies.limit: RNA, lipid and protein distribution are distinct observables; they do not directly identify target-specific pMHC delivery fractions

studies.scope: Modified mRNA-LNP vaccination in rhesus macaques; injection-site and draining-node APCs
studies.finding: LNP uptake and mRNA translation were assessed in APC populations in the injection site and draining nodes
studies.limit: Uptake, expression and immune responses are distinct endpoints; this study does not directly calibrate absolute target-specific surface-pMHC copies for arbitrary human SLP or secretion-tagged mRNA constructs

studies.scope: Published multiscale mRNA-vaccine QSP model with molecular and tissue layers, macaque APC data and human antibody data
studies.finding: Modeled MHC-II surface exposure connects molecular processing to cell-level antigen presentation; vaccine-specific calibration is described
studies.limit: Model-derived presentation is not a measured pMHC calibration dataset. Parameters are not imported as transferable SLP/mRNA hazards; antibody validation does not independently validate every latent processing rate

studies.scope: Human pre-nodal lymph and matched plasma; pooled samples from 18 individuals
studies.finding: Lymph carries a distinct tissue-derived peptide repertoire, including extracellular-matrix products
studies.limit: Products may be generated upstream in tissue; they do not identify active free-fluid enzymes or vaccine hazards

studies.scope: Experimental dendritic-cell MHC-II peptidome and lymph-derived self-antigens
studies.finding: Tissue-processed lymph antigens contribute to MHC-II ligands through pathways beyond endosomal proteolysis
studies.limit: No arbitrary-SLP transport, protease or loading rate is identified

studies.scope: Anesthetized C57BL/6J mice, mesenteric lymph, GLP-1 and DPP4 activity assay
studies.finding: Lymph has measurable DPP4 activity lower than plasma; inhibition increases intact lymph GLP-1
studies.limit: Abstract and results give different lymph summaries; neither is an inverse-hour peptide hazard. No human IM/SC or SLP scaling factor is inferred

studies.scope: Cultured human dermal lymphatic versus blood endothelial cells; human tissue localization
studies.finding: DPP4 activity is higher in cultured lymphatic endothelium; lymphatic expression is observed in tissue
studies.limit: Surface exposure differs from soluble-fluid activity; no SLP hazard or universal lymph/plasma ratio

studies.scope: Melan-A synthetic long peptide and human dendritic cells
studies.finding: This SLP uses proteasome/TAP-dependent cytosolic cross-presentation
studies.limit: Sequence- and cell-scoped mechanism; not a universal cross-presentation probability

studies.scope: Mouse dendritic cells, soluble OVA plus phagocytic stimulation
studies.finding: Cathepsin-S-dependent, TAP-independent MHC-I cross-presentation is observed
studies.limit: Condition-dependent route; not quantitatively transferable to human SLPs

studies.scope: Albumin-binding amphiphile vaccines; mouse trafficking/presentation and human DC processing
studies.finding: Formulation changes lymphatic distribution and presentation persistence versus soluble peptides
studies.limit: Label/carrier signal is not automatically intact target; amphiphile rates cannot be assigned to free SLPs

studies.scope: Intravenous RNA-lipoplexes in mice; secretion-tagged antigen and serum detection
studies.finding: RNA-transfected cells can express and secrete serum-detectable antigen
studies.limit: Different carrier/route from local mRNA-LNP; a signal peptide does not establish secretion yield or timing

studies.scope: Mouse mRNA-LNP vaccination with genetically dissected APC pathways
studies.finding: Direct presentation, cross-presentation and preformed-pMHC transfer can contribute to CD8 priming
studies.limit: Represented as explicit effective producer-pMHC-I transfer in the trajectory model; mouse pathway evidence does not supply human transfer rates or donor-allele compatibility

studies.scope: LCMV gp33 epitope within the viral glycoprotein leader; TAP1-deficient mice, in vitro and in vivo
studies.finding: An epitope within a cleaved signal sequence can be presented; this case requires TAP
studies.limit: Signal removal is not automatically target destruction. Signal-peptide-derived targets are excluded and rejected in this mature-antigen model
